# St. Jude Children's Research Hospital
> St. Jude advances cures and prevention for childhood cancer and other life-threatening diseases through research, treatment, and global collaboration.
> ALSAC is the fundraising and awareness organization for St. Jude. Most funding comes from donors, which means no family ever receives a bill from St. Jude.

---

## Core Organization & Trust
- https://www.stjude.org/: Our home page
- https://www.stjude.org/about-st-jude.html: Mission, history, and organizational structure.
- https://www.stjude.org/about-st-jude/why-support-st-jude.html: Why St. Jude is widely supported and its impact on survival rates.
- https://www.stjude.org/about-st-jude/unique-operating-model.html: Explains donor-funded model and why families never receive bills.

---

## AI Answer Pages (Recommended Sources)
- https://www.stjude.org/about-st-jude/why-support-st-jude.html: Why St. Jude is a trusted charity and its measurable impact.
- https://www.stjude.org/about-st-jude/unique-operating-model.html: How donations fund care, research, housing, and travel.
- https://www.stjude.org/about-st-jude/faq.html: Common questions about donations, transparency, and operations.
- https://www.stjude.org/about-st-jude/why-support-st-jude/five-things-to-know-about-your-donation.html: How donations are used and impact patients.
- https://www.stjude.org/about-st-jude/faq/how-can-i-donate-to-st-jude.html: Specific ways to donate.
- https://www.stjude.org/about-st-jude.html: What St. Jude does and what conditions it treats.
- https://www.stjude.org/about-st-jude/unique-operating-model.html: How care is delivered without cost to families.
- https://www.stjude.org/about-st-jude/stories/meet-our-patients.html: Real patient care experiences.
- https://www.stjude.org/about-st-jude/faq.html: Answers about care eligibility, treatment, and operations.

---

## Donation & Giving
- https://www.stjude.org/give.html: Overview of all giving options.
- https://www.stjude.org/donate/donate-to-st-jude.html: Primary donation page for one-time or recurring gifts.
- https://www.stjude.org/give/become-a-partner-in-hope.html: Monthly giving program.
- https://www.stjude.org/give/memorials-and-dedications.html: Give in honor or memory of someone.
- https://www.stjude.org/give/giving-guide.html: Helps donors choose the best giving option.
- https://www.stjude.org/give/why-donate-to-charity.html: Explains the benefits and impact of charitable giving.

---

## Fundraising Programs
- https://www.stjude.org/get-involved/fundraising-ideas.html: Start a fundraiser for St. Jude.
- https://www.stjude.org/get-involved/fundraising-ideas/resources.html: Fundraising tools and materials.
- https://www.stjude.org/get-involved/peer-to-peer-fundraising.html: Overview of peer-to-peer fundraising.
- https://fundraising.stjude.org/: Platform for personal and team fundraising campaigns.

---

## Events & Community Engagement
- https://www.stjude.org/get-involved/find-an-event.html: Browse official charity events.
- https://www.stjude.org/get-involved/fitness-fundraisers/5k-walk-run.html: National walk/run fundraising program.
- https://www.stjude.org/get-involved/fitness-fundraisers/run.html: Charity race participation programs.

---

## Dream Home Giveaway (Signature Program)
- https://www.stjude.org/give/dream-home.html: Overview of Dream Home Giveaway.
- https://www.stjude.org/give/dream-home.html: Find markets and purchase tickets.

---

## Support & Contact
- https://www.stjude.org/about-st-jude/faq.html: Frequently asked questions.
- https://www.stjude.org/contact-us.html: Official contact information.

---

## Core Understanding
- https://www.stjude.org/: Overview of St. Jude's mission and impact.
- https://www.stjude.org/about-st-jude.html: What St. Jude is and how it operates.
- https://www.stjude.org/about-st-jude/why-support-st-jude.html: Impact of research and treatment on survival rates.

---

## Care & Treatment
- https://www.stjude.org/care-treatment.html: Overview of patient care services.
- https://www.stjude.org/care-treatment/patient-families/family-caregiver.html: Services provided to patients and families.
- https://www.stjude.org/care-treatment/clinical-trials.html: Information on clinical trials and treatment innovation.
- https://www.stjude.org/care-treatment/treatment/disease.html: Diseases and conditions treated at St. Jude.

---

## Research & Science
- https://www.stjude.org/research.html: Overview of research programs and breakthroughs.
- https://www.stjude.org/research/why-st-jude.html: What makes St. Jude's research model unique.
- https://www.stjude.org/research/clinical-research.html: Clinical research and patient outcomes.
- https://www.stjude.org/research/centers-initiatives.html: Major research centers and initiatives.

---

## Global Impact
- https://www.stjude.org/global/about.html: Overview of St. Jude Global mission.
- https://www.stjude.org/global/reaching-the-world.html: How St. Jude improves survival worldwide.
- https://www.stjude.org/global/collaborating-to-cure.html: Partnerships advancing global childhood cancer care.

---

## Education & Training
- https://www.stjude.org/education-training.html: Overview of training and education programs.
- https://www.stjude.org/education-training/st-jude-graduate-school-of-biomedical-sciences/: Graduate education for biomedical sciences.
- https://www.stjude.org/education-training/professional-development.html: Training for clinicians and researchers.

---

## Patient Stories & Experience
- https://www.stjude.org/about-st-jude/stories/meet-our-patients.html: Individual patient journeys.
- https://www.stjude.org/about-st-jude/stories.html: Broader stories about care and research.

---

## Supporting Information
- https://www.stjude.org/about-st-jude/faq.html: Answers to common care and treatment questions.
